Additionally, Hydroxyurea is connected to Hereditary Site-specific Ovarian Cancer Syndrome, which also leads to Ovarian Adenocarcinoma via Topotecan. These pathways suggest that Hydroxyurea may influence the development of ovarian cancer through mechanisms involving tumor progression or treatment response. The evidence is supported by a combination of indication links, with varying scores indicating the strength of the relationships. The integration of these pathways highlights the potential role of Hydroxyurea in the pathogenesis of Ovarian Adenocarcinoma, though the exact mechanisms remain to be fully elucidated.
